verdict.rationale: Adyen documents offering 'all their preferred payment methods with a single integration,' and its online-payments docs describe accepting 'cards, wallets, and local payment methods' through the same Checkout API, including a /paymentMethods endpoint. A hands-on implementer independently confirms it offered 'every payment option under the sun,' including bank redirects like iDEAL and Sofort. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Apple Pay support, of BNPL methods, and of Google Pay in standard (non-agentic) checkout.
